 Follow Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes make TV comeback just days after their exes' wedding
 Maria Sarabi Tue, November 10, 2026 at 10:23 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Amy Robach and TJ Holmes in LA (GC Images) Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes returned to the screen as they appeared in the November 9 episode of Name That Tune . 
 The couple faced off against each other during the show, with T.J. competing for the Chloe and Maude Foundation and his wife raising money for the Under 40 Foundation. The pair competed in the Big-a-Note round as they attempted to name the biggest wedding songs. They both had $3,000.
 Neither Amy or T.J. recognized Ed Sheeran's hit "Thinking Out Loud" and both failed to offer an answer. When Robin Thicke played the song in full, T.J. pulled his wife in for a sweet dance. "Romance is in the air," said host Jane Krakowski.
 Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes on Name That Tune (@ Fox)
 The couple stepped back from hosting GMA3 in 2023. Amy had worked for ABC News since 2012, and T.J. had been with them since 2014. The pair had anchored GMA3  together since 2020, alongside their former co-star Dr. Jennifer Ashton.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Their relationship first made headlines after paparazzi photographed them embracing while both were still married to their former spouses. At the time, it was not yet public knowledge that they had already separated from their partners. They married privately in Arkansas on September 19, 2026.
 T.J. Holmes, Amy Robach hosted GMA3 (@ FilmMagic)
 In January 2023, People released a statement from an ABC spokesman which read:  "After several productive conversations with Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes about different options, we all agreed it's best for everyone that they move on from ABC News. We recognize their talent and commitment over the years and are thankful for their contributions."
 During an exclusive chat with HELLO! at iHeartRadio 102.7 KIIS FM's Jingle Ball 2025 at Intuit Dome on December 5, T.J. and Amy addressed the possibility of stepping back into the spotlight. When asked if their plans for 2026 involve a new network, TJ replied: "Per chance." The speculation intensified after reports surfaced that CBS executives were considering bringing the duo back for a new morning show.
 The couple married in 2026 (@ FilmMagic)
 Marilee Fiebig's marries Andrew Shue
 Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue tied the knot in November (@ Getty)
 Amy and T.J.'s appearance on Name That Tune comes after their respective exes got married on November 1. Marilee Fiebig and Andrew Shue exchanged vows at their New Jersey farm . Andrew was previously married to Amy, while Marilee was married to T.J. Both divorces were finalized in 2023. Andrew announced in October that he and Marilee had quietly become engaged in the spring, after a relationship that became public in December 2023.
